name: RIGHT_LANE_ENDS_YELLOW_DIAMOND
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W4-SA101: '120 DN' = Series D at narrow spacing — drawn with the FHWA Series D at minus10 tracking, which reproduces the stated RIGHT 420 (210 | 210) and ENDS 381 (186 | 195); LANE is stated 388 (194 | 194) and comes to 381 (sheet-vs-font). 190 pitch. Diamond 750 side, drawn in its 1060.66 bounding square (centre 530.33); yellow, R50, 10 / 30 (edge 10 + border 20). W4-SA101B illustrated (C 900, D 1200). Lines centred on the vertical centre line unless noted; the sheet dimensions the legend from the centre lines — vertical positions here are the sheet's (checked against the ink at 1200 dpi): RIGHT 120 D, baseline -133 from the horizontal centre line (top 277), ink 420 (measured 416, centred); LANE 120 D, baseline +57 from the horizontal centre line (top 467) (measured 383, x 337-720); ENDS 120 D, baseline +246 from the horizontal centre line (top 656), ink 381 (measured 378, x 345-723).
